headers.//: Long cache at the Vercel edge, short cache in the browser. Vercel purges the edge on every deploy, so a new or corrected file goes live for everyone straight away. The browser re-checks after an hour, so a 404 served before a file existed can only strand for an hour rather than a year. These filenames are not content-hashed, so 'immutable' was never safe here.
Fonts stay pinned. Their filenames change if the font does.
